title: Quadruple 2-input NOR buffer with open-collector

functions.text: 1Y is the NOR of 1A, 1B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up.
2Y is the NOR of 2A, 2B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up.
3Y is the NOR of 3A, 3B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up.
4Y is the NOR of 4A, 4B. Open collector: the high level needs an outside pull-up.

electrical.notes: Open-collector buffer: IOL 48 mA vs 16 mA for 7402: can drive three times as many inputs or a long line. Open collector: no IOH figure applies; the datasheet gives an off-state leakage of max 0.25 mA at VOH 5.5 V instead.

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 (the scan prints kohm), CL 50 pF
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 (the scan prints kohm), CL 50 pF
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 133 (the scan prints kohm), CL 150 pF

unknown: Load resistor unit in the switching table: the scan reads '133 kohm'; the sister parts 7428/7437/7438 print 133 ohm. Not settled from the 7433 sheet itself.
notes: The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delay; minNs is null (the path-delay function uses 0 ns). No setup/hold/pulse-width limits apply to a gate, so timingLimits is empty.
